items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Corn Eye and Gavis or Corn Eye and Johnson, Corn Eye and Nero.

ctx.x: So we're talking about Mardi Gras. Where's the best place and what's the best time to find the Indians?

The best place is on Corn Eye Street. Corn Eye and Gavis or Corn Eye and Johnson, Corn Eye and Nero. Well, there's one group that meets around there every year. I beat up the Yallapocahunters, they call them. Yeah, you'll find them.
What time was the best time?
